discovery_method: Two batches of four general web queries plus direct primary-source opens/finds. General searches are discovery only and are not counted as native bibliographic database searches.
limitations: Only selected outgoing/incoming citations checked; no complete cited-by list exported.
No primary target body is labelled read merely because it appears in a bibliography.
No inference of novelty absence from a search result or citation edge.
External human repetition and opinion remain pending.
